Also there's https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-4396 <dannyryan> On mainnet we see 99%+ of blocks so in the normal case, the average is in fact right at 12 But yes, it could theoretically be much longer on average <dannyryan> +1 on the 1559 proposal that takes into account slots I remember <@!415548822983278593> mentioning that someone needs to look into if this changes the block proposers incentives wrt what timestamp they include <dannyryan> Timestamp is a protocol rule in pos so can't be modified if you have a proposal for a slot <dannyryan> But yeah I remember a desire to not rush it due to incentives and other things to consider ok did not know that <dannyryan> Yeah if I'm assigned to slot N, then time is strictly beacon_genesis_time + N*SECONDS_PER_SLOT CL enforces this I mention it each chance I get, and I believe <@486501030046203915> created https://willthemergelowergasprices.org Feel free to share, and if there are venues where you think we can better educate folks on the merge, always happy to do a talk/Q&A/etc Re: 4396, I think it’s more a question of “when” rather than “if” at this point. Seems obviously valuable, but so are many other things that are proposed for Shanghai 😅 The post-merge data on the fee market should help determine how urgent it is to include in practice For the CL impls, I'm interested in the behaviour when the user does not specify a `suggested_fee_recipient`. Do you fail to produce a block, or produce with some default recipient (e.g., 0x00..00). I'm tempted to get LH to produce with the zero-address and be very loud in the logs. We can get the VC to refuse to start without a `--suggested-fee-recipient` flag, however it's valid to start a BN without knowing a fee recip if it doesn't need to produce blocks. do you specify it in BN and VC? And VC can override BN default? yeah, that's right I think Teku will fail to produce blocks if it's not set (and it is indeed very loud about this at startup and block production). Defaulting to the 0 address is the other option we considered but I feel nervous about providing a default even if it is 0 - not entirely sure that's rational... There's a bit of a race-condition, where a VC might produce a block on a BN before it's sent the `prepare` API call to communicate the fee recip. It means users might be prudent to have a "catch all" fee recip address on their BNs, in case the VC isn't able to communicate the message to the BN. Perhaps adding the `suggested_fee_recipient` to the `GET /validator/blocks` endpoint is a solution to this. Here's an issue about it: https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/issues/187
